title.narrative: Secondments to the Global Fund Geneva

description.narrative: This activity Secondments to the Global Fund Geneva is a component of UK investment in the Global Fund 2020-2022 to reduce transmission and mortality for HIV AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria through treatments, diagnostics and preventive technologies and related services reported by FCDO with a funding type of 116 - Front Line Delivery and a budget of £829,419. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Administrative costs (non-sector allocable).

mailing-address.narrative: Public Enquiry Point, Abercrombie House, Eaglesham Road, East Kilbride, Glasgow G75 8EA
